FINAL ANSWER: 849 sites are removed.

When filtering out Zebra Finch CpG sites that do NOT show >90% or <10% methylation, 849 of the 1,140 unique sites are removed (the 291 sites that show at least one extreme-methylation sample are kept).

Method (executed, verifiable in analysis.py):
- Loaded data/ZF_AgeRelated_CpG_noMT_Final.csv (19,698 data rows, no nulls).
- Defined a site as a unique (Chromosome, StartPosition, EndPosition) tuple → 1,140 sites (each measured across up to 20 samples).
- Flagged extreme rows with strict inequality: MethylationPercentage > 90 OR < 10 (539 rows: 268 above 90, 271 below 10).
- Aggregated ANY per site → 291 sites show an extreme value (kept), 849 sites show none (removed).
- Sensitivity check (inclusive >=90 or <=10): would remove 837 sites; reported final answer uses strict boundaries = 849.
